header.title: Some Things I’ve Built
header.subtitle: A collection of selected projects showcasing my engineering and design skills.

items.title: localization_gen (pub.dev)
items.descriptions: Type-safe localization generator for Flutter/Dart with nested JSON support and a powerful CLI.
items.details: A localization code generator focused on DX: nested JSON support, modular organization, parameter interpolation, pluralization, gender/context forms, watch mode, and multi-command CLI workflows. Designed to keep i18n strongly typed and scalable as your app grows.

items.title: automation_keys_gen (pub.dev)
items.descriptions: Enforces a consistent automation key contract for Flutter UI tests with CLI validation and docs generation.
items.details: A Flutter testing utility that standardizes automation keys across the codebase. Includes a CLI for validation and generates Markdown documentation so QA and developers share the same contract. Helps prevent flaky UI tests caused by inconsistent or undocumented keys.

items.title: idle_activity_detector (pub.dev)
items.descriptions: Detects user idle/activity states with comprehensive browser event support and configurable timeouts.
items.details: A cross-platform Flutter package for detecting user idle vs active state. On web it listens to mouse/keyboard/scroll/touch events for better accuracy. Useful for auto-logout, session timeout warnings, and engagement tracking.

items.title: HORA Pro
items.descriptions: HR & Employee Management System — Mobile App for Attendance, Shift, and Performance Tracking
items.details: HORA Pro is a comprehensive HR and employee management system that puts workforce control in your hands. Features include shift management, attendance timer, facial recognition, leave requests, text chat, real-time GPS tracking, performance ranking, activity logs, monthly custom reports, anti-fake GPS, and promotions. Trusted by over 100 companies and 1,000 active users, HORA Pro helps improve employee discipline and HR efficiency.

items.title: React App Boilerplate
items.descriptions: Scalable React + TypeScript boilerplate — built with modular and clean architecture
items.details: React App Boilerplate is a modern frontend template built with React 19 and TypeScript 5, featuring a modular structure inspired by Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design principles. It integrates Vite, TailwindCSS, Zustand, Awilix (DI), and multi-language support via i18next. Designed for high performance, maintainability, and scalability for large-scale projects. Provides clear separation between core, shared, and feature layers for maximum clarity and extensibility.

items.title: Go REST API Boilerplate
items.descriptions: Modular Golang REST API template — with multi-environment support and Docker-ready setup
items.details: Go REST API Boilerplate is a production-ready REST API template built with Golang, featuring a modular architecture inspired by Clean Architecture principles. It supports multiple environments (development, testing, production), full Docker integration, and includes essential features such as JWT authentication, GORM ORM, transaction management, and persistent file uploads. Designed for building scalable applications like SaaS platforms, HR systems, training platforms, or data management services.
